bullets.title: The Moth Presents — Stephanie Peirolo: Walking with RJ
bullets.note: This is an incredibly moving and brutal 12-minute video. I include this in the Thanksgiving edition of “5-Bullet Friday” (in the US, of course) deliberately. It helps put things in perspective, and it made me reconsider my “stresses” as almost entirely absurd. For anyone reading this newsletter, there is indeed much to be thankful for. My sincerest gratitude to Stephanie ([@speirolo](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/92uv0r9rmwtnhd9x7qi0/0qawh9hx49opdd/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9zcGVpcm9sbw==)) for the gift of this talk.

bullets.title: “At a recent party, I found a poet who had brought a typewriter to provide poems on the spot. He asked for words as prompts to get things started. I offered ‘darkness’ and quite liked the elegance of what he wrote in less than 60 seconds (pic). Good food for thought, even if simply a thought experiment…”

bullets.title: Alan Watts and Superposition — Listen, Dream
bullets.note: For me, Alan Watts can be hit or miss, but this is definitely a hit. Coupled with the ambient music, I find this meditation perfect for grounding myself when I’m making coffee in the morning. Here’s a shortened description of the project: “Superposition is an immersion into the inner universe, a meditative antidote to a world of digital overwhelm. Created by [Justin Boreta](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/92uv0r9rmwtnhd9x7qi0/eluph7hezlpd04/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE1LzAyLzIzL2dsaXRjaC1tb2IvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9Y29udmVydGtpdCZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWNvbnZlcnRraXQmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTViZg==) ([@boreta](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/92uv0r9rmwtnhd9x7qi0/o3ikhqhne6k0r5/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9ib3JldGE=)) and [Matthew Davis](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/92uv0r9rmwtnhd9x7qi0/plfeh9hde23pzr/aHR0cDovL25hbWV0aGVtYWNoaW5lLmNvbS9hYm91dC8=) ([@davisville](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/92uv0r9rmwtnhd9x7qi0/63teh8hw45k37z/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9kYXZpc3ZpbGxlLw==)), this ambient project and record label emerged from the shared search for serenity by two curious artists.”
